subject: Next steps: PoC runway & deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@healthsync.ai>, Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@carebridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: PoC runway & deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed path so we can get your PoC scheduled without surprises. I pulled notes from the discovery and highlighted the open items we need from your side to finalize the deployment mode: Hosted API vs Dedicated capacity vs Private VPC/on-prem.

Recap (from today's demo):
- Primary use: document ingestion + assisted triage (PHI may appear in notes).
- Target throughput: ~8–12 inference QPS during business hours, burst to 30 QPS for scheduled jobs.
- Latency expectation: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 600ms (for user-facing flows).
- Retention: logs retained for 90 days; raw documents must not leave customer-controlled storage.

Open / decision items (please confirm):
1) Data residency & PHI handling — do you require customer-managed KMS and VPC-only access (Private VPC) or is Dedicated capacity with VPC peering acceptable?
2) Timeline constraints — when can your infra/IT team allocate time for the integration sprint?
3) Success criteria for PoC — does the below list align with your goals?
   - Integrate ingestion pipeline + 2 example workflows
   - Achieve p50 < 200ms on sample workload
   - End-to-end annotation accuracy within current SLAs (we'll baseline)
   - Sign-off from security on evidence artifacts

Proposed PoC plan (4-week runway):
- Week 0 (prep): finalize deployment mode & sign MSA/POC SOW; exchange IP allowlists and service accounts.
- Week 1: infra provisioning (Hosted trial or Dedicated pool reservation / Private VPC network setup).
- Week 2: integration + run synthetic workload; begin monitoring.
- Week 3: real-data validation (anonymized samples where required); collect metrics and QA.
- Week 4: review, iterate, and deliver final artifact + MOP for production rollout.

Stakeholder slate we expect to engage:
- CareBridge: Elena (CTO), Rajesh (IT/Security), product owner (TBD)
- Redwood: myself (PoC lead), Ben Carter (Dedicated capacity & infra), Priyom Das (solutions / integration)

Next asks from you: please confirm (a) preferred deployment mode, (b) named security contact (email), and (c) target week to start. If you'd like, we can start with a short hosted trial to validate end-to-end integration while we provision Dedicated/Private VPC.

I'll attach a tentative PoC criteria workbook and a short cost delta between Hosted vs Dedicated for your review.

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0187

Attachments referenced: PoC-criteria.xlsx (draft), Hosted-vs-Dedicated-cost-estimate.pdf
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@healthsync.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@carebridge.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: PoC runway & deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Tessa —

Appreciate the succinct recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Deployment mode: Due to PHI concerns and our compliance posture, we prefer Private VPC with customer-managed KMS. If that path extends lead time materially, we are open to starting with Dedicated capacity behind VPC peering as a short-term measure. Hosted is a last resort.
- Timeline: We can kick off infra prep in ~3 weeks — Rajesh will confirm exact availability but expects to allocate a systems engineer the week of Sep 21.
- Security contact: Rajesh Patel (r.patel@carebridge.com) — Cc'ing him on this thread.

Success criteria look correct. I'll send our SOC2 checklist and a short security questionnaire (attached) so you can pre-check any gaps.

One more ask: can Redwood provide a minimal set of integration docs for the ingestion pipeline (S3/GCS connectors and signed URL flow)? That will speed the integration.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Kapoor | Head of Product Integrations, HealthSync (partnering with CareBridge)
Mobile: +1-650-555-0321

Attachments: CareBridge_Security_QA.pdf

On Wed, Sep 1, 2026 at 3:12 PM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [original message quoted]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: PoC runway & deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Tessa — quick internal note to capture operational constraints.

- Dedicated capacity lead time: depending on GPU type requested, we should plan ~2–3 weeks for pool reservation and validation. If CareBridge insists on a specific quantization/latency profile we'll need the sample prompts ahead of time for kernel tuning.
- Private VPC/on-prem: network handshakes and KMS onboarding typically add another 1–2 weeks on top of Dedicated provisioning (firewall rules, BGP/peering windows at the customer's cloud infra).
- Fallback plan suggestion: start a Hosted trial to validate ingestion + functional accuracy in Week 1, concurrently provision Dedicated/Private environment. Hosted trial should be locked to sample set only (no PHI).

Action items for Redwood ops: Priyom, can you draft the minimal integration checklist (S3 signed URL + auth flow + sample payload) and estimated capacity config for 10/30 QPS by EOD Friday? Ben — can you run a quick capacity delta for r5 vs a100 variants so we can recommend cost/time tradeoffs?

Ben Carter | Head of Dedicated Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Next steps: PoC runway & deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Thanks Samir / Rajesh — appreciate the quick confirmations. Updated mutual action plan and timeline below. I want to lock these items so procurement and your security team have clarity.

Mutual action plan (agreed):
- By Sep 10: CareBridge to confirm final deployment mode (Private VPC preferred) and sign PoC SOW. Rajesh to provide network contacts and any onboarding windows.
- Sep 13–17 (Week 1): Redwood provides integration checklist, PoC-criteria workbook, and a hosted sandbox for non-PHI validation (optional).
- Sep 20–Oct 8 (Weeks 2–4): Provision Dedicated/Private environment + integration + validation. Redwood to deliver weekly metrics dashboard and bi-weekly check-ins.
- Oct 9: PoC review meeting and go/no-go decision.

Success criteria (finalized):
- p50 latency < 200ms on representative workload
- Throughput: sustain 10 QPS with bursts to 30 QPS during scheduled jobs
- Security sign-off on evidence artifacts (network diagrams, KMS config, audit logs)
- Integration: end-to-end ingestion and anonymized sample pass rate > 95% on target workflows

Attachments: PoC-criteria.xlsx (draft) — I uploaded the workbook and a short notes doc to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-PoC-CareBridge.

Next meeting: Thu Sep 16, 10:00 AM PT — 30 min to review integration checklist and confirm PoC SOW items (calendar invite to follow).

If that's aligned, Rajesh / Elena — please confirm and we'll convert the plan into a short SOW for signature.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
